title: Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.16), Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda cites Rabbi Akiva in the name of Rabbi Panda, etc. Hyman prefers the reading he reports from Dikdukei Soferim: Rabbi Bizna or Bidata cites Rabbi Zeira, who cites Rav Ukva in Rabbi Panda’s name. Hyman reports that in Yuchasin, Rabbi Bita bar Bizna speaks in the name of Rabbi Ukva.

notes.text: The consulted [Berakhot 55b:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.16) continues from Rabbi Panda to Rav Nachum and Rabbi Birim, who reports in the name of an elder identified as Rabbi Bana’ah. Hyman quotes only the beginning of that chain here.
